race.comment: EASY BEAST (6) has won 10 of his 100 starts and was brave in defeat last time out when leading up, before finishing second by just over 3 lengths. He might try similar tactics here, and with fitness on his side, he could take some pegging back again. HEART'S EMBRACE (5) has needed both of her runs back from a spell, and she will find this easier than his last run over 2000m at Warracknabeal 11 days ago. King Callow replacing an apprentice is the key here, and the pair merits healthy respect. I LOVE THIS SONG (9) has not been far away in any of his recent racing, and he is nicely placed in this after a 2kg claim. His record on this track over the trip is only modest, but he is still in it with a top 4 chance. VALUED (1) does not help himself by settling well off the pace in his races, but he is often hitting the line hard late in the run home. If the race is run to suit him, then he can have the last say. TURNED LOOSE (7) is backing up quickly, and she did have an excuse last start.
